note: All URLs tested live on 2026-09-27 (IST) with curl/python3 (requests-equivalent) using a browser-like User-Agent and >=1s spacing between requests to the same host, unless marked otherwise. 'Today' per task instructions is 2026-09-27.

sources.publisher: NPS Trust (National Pension System Trust) - npstrust.org.in
sources.content: Full daily NAV history FROM SCHEME INCEPTION for one (PFM, scheme) pair. Columns: ID, DATE OF NAV, PFM ID, PFM NAME, SCHEME ID, SCHEME NAME, NAV VALUE.
sources.format: Tab-separated text served with Content-Type application/vnd.ms-excel and a filename ending .xls (it is NOT a binary Excel file - it is plain TSV text; read with pandas.read_csv(sep='\t') or Python csv module).
sources.history_depth: From scheme inception. Verified for SBI Pension Funds (PFM001): Scheme E/C/G Tier I (SM001003/SM001004/SM001005) both go back to 2009-05-05 (4260 daily rows each); Scheme A Tier I (SM001012) goes back to 2016-10-10 (2421 rows). Depth will vary by PFM/scheme - each PFM's Scheme E/C/G Tier I usually dates to that PFM's own launch (see nav-report-excel below for per-PFM inception dates, e.g. UTI/LIC/ICICI/Kotak/SBI ~2009, HDFC 2013, Aditya Birla 2017, Axis/Tata/DSP 2022-2023).
sources.method: Single HTTP GET, no auth, no cookies required. Params: navcatdataxls = PFM code (PFM001=SBI, PFM002=UTI, PFM003=LIC, PFM005=Kotak, PFM007=ICICI, PFM008=HDFC, PFM010=Aditya Birla, PFM011=Tata, PFM013=Axis, PFM014=DSP). navsubdataxls = scheme code in 'SMxxxxxx' format (e.g. SM001003). navyearselxls=all returns full history; other tested values (1/3/5/7/10/inception/custom) plus getFromd/getTod (YYYY-MM-DD) did NOT change the output in testing (server ignored the date-range filter and still returned full inception-to-date history when navyearselxls=all) - treat this endpoint as 'always returns everything from inception', filter client-side.
sources.update_timing: Latest row observed 2026-09-25 when checked 2026-09-27 (Sunday) - i.e. NAVs lag by roughly 2 calendar days / next trading day close-of-business. No NAV rows exist for non-trading days (weekends/holidays).
sources.terms: No scheme/endpoint-specific terms found. NPS Trust site-wide disclaimer (https://npstrust.org.in/disclosures, checked 2026-09-27) disclaims liability/accuracy but does not prohibit reuse of data. See pfrda_copyright_policy entry below for the closest explicit reuse permission found (PFRDA-hosted, not NPS-Trust-hosted).
sources.discovered_via: Not linked from any HTML page we found; the exact URL and params were recovered from the open-source Python package BharatFinTrack (https://github.com/debpal/BharatFinTrack, file BharatFinTrack/nps.py, method NPS.scheme_historical_nav), which itself hits this same npstrust.org.in endpoint. Confirms this is the backend that powers the 'Scheme wise NAV' download button on https://npstrust.org.in/weekly-snapshot-nps-schemes.
sources.recommendation: BEST source for backfilling/refreshing full per-scheme daily NAV history. One GET per (PFM, scheme) pair covers that scheme's entire life; re-run periodically (e.g. nightly) and diff/append new rows.

sources.content: Latest available NAV for ALL schemes of ALL PFMs in one call (264 rows when checked). Columns: ID, DATE OF NAV, PFM NAME, SCHEME ID, SCHEME NAME, NAV VALUE.
sources.format: Tab-separated text (same mislabeled-as-xls pattern as above).
sources.history_depth: Latest date only (single snapshot, no history).
sources.method: Single HTTP GET, no params, no auth.
sources.update_timing: Returned DATE OF NAV = 2026-09-25 when checked 2026-09-27 - same ~2-day lag as above; this is the authoritative full scheme list+code map, useful to refresh the simulator's scheme registry (PFM name, scheme name, scheme code) on a schedule.
sources.recommendation: Use this to auto-discover the current universe of scheme codes (new MSF schemes, discontinuations e.g. Max Life PFM012 dropped 18-04-2025) before looping the per-scheme historical endpoint above.

sources.content: Official period returns table per scheme-category per PFM: Inception Date, AUM (Rs Cr), Subscribers, NAV, Returns 1/3/5/7/10-Year and Since-Inception (annualised, decimal fractions e.g. 0.0834=8.34%).
sources.history_depth: Point-in-time snapshot per file; archive list of past weekly snapshots found only back to 2025 (e.g. 26 Sep 2025 through 28 Nov 2025 in the archive index fetched 2026-09-27) - the archive index itself appears not to have been extended into 2026 even though the live comparison page shows current 'as on' dates (25 Sep 2026 observed) - GAP: could not find a stable predictable URL/pattern for weekly files beyond Nov 2025 in the archive list; the exact current-week file's URL was not located (the underlying AJAX/download-button endpoint for the *current* week's XLS was not reverse-engineered in the time available).
sources.method: Direct static-file GET for any already-known archived filename (verified working for weekly_return_as_on_28_November_2025.xlsx). Discovering NEW filenames programmatically requires periodically re-scraping https://npstrust.org.in/archive-list-of-scheme-graphs for newly added links.
sources.update_timing: Nominally weekly per file name pattern; archive index staleness noted above is a gap.
sources.terms: Same NPS Trust site disclaimer as above.
sources.recommendation: Good structured source for official period returns (1/3/5/7/10yr, since inception) per PFM per scheme-category to display alongside/validate the NAV-derived XIRR the simulator computes itself. Treat as secondary/cross-check, not primary feed, due to the discoverability gap on the very latest file.

sources.url: https://npstrust.org.in/sites/default/files/scheme_retuen_pdf/Scheme_G_Tier_I_0.pdf (and sibling files per scheme category, linked from https://npstrust.org.in/scheme-financials)
sources.content: Per-scheme-category return/AUM/NAV/holdings table across all PFMs, plus benchmark returns and methodology footnote ('Scheme Returns for more than 01 year are annualised').
sources.history_depth: Single point-in-time snapshot embedded in the PDF.
sources.update_timing: STALE - the file downloaded and checked on 2026-09-27 is dated 'as on 29-Dec-23' (Last-Modified header: Fri, 12 Jan 2024). This PDF has evidently NOT been refreshed in almost 3 years despite living on the current site. NOT reliable for an auto-refreshing simulator.
sources.recommendation: Do not use for automated refresh. Useful only as a one-off citation for the official returns-methodology footnote text.

sources.content: Interactive page (Drupal 9.5.11 custom modules) with 'Scheme Returns' chart, 'NAV Chart' (feeds the two endpoints above), and a 'Return Comparison Chart'. Contains the official one-line statement: "NPS does not offer any fixed returns. The returns under NPS are market-linked." and disclaimer "Investments in NPS are subject to market risk... NPS Trust does not guarantee or assure any returns."
sources.method: The underlying AJAX endpoints /list-of-navy-comparison-graphs and /autogetdata-comparison-graph (query params navdata=<PFM codes>&subdata=<internal numeric scheme-category id>&yearsel=<n|custom>) were located in the page's JS (modules/custom/nav_comparison_graphs/js/get_details.js) but a test call returned 'Invalid Data' with the numeric scheme-category IDs scraped from the dropdown (e.g. 882 for 'SCHEME E - TIER I GS') - these IDs are NPS-Trust-internal Drupal node/category IDs, not the public 'SMxxxxxx' scheme codes, and the exact working combination was not solved in the time available. GAP - do not rely on this internal API; use the two report-excel endpoints above instead, which are simpler, documented (via BharatFinTrack) and confirmed working.
sources.update_timing: Live page confirmed showing 'Returns as on 25th September, 2026' on the 2026-09-27 check.
sources.recommendation: Use only as the authoritative citation for the 'no fixed returns, market-linked' design principle and for discovering dropdown option lists (PFM codes, sector/category names) by re-scraping the HTML select elements periodically.

sources.publisher: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd (formerly NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Ltd), Central Recordkeeping Agency #1 - npscra.proteantech.in (migrated from npscra.nsdl.co.in)
sources.content: One CSV per calendar day, ALL schemes of ALL PFMs for that day. Columns (no header row): MM/DD/YYYY, PFM code, PFM name, scheme code (SMxxxxxx), scheme name, NAV. 274 rows in the 2026-09-22 sample.
sources.format: ZIP containing a single .out file that is plain comma-delimited text.
sources.history_depth: Tested working dates back to 2009-05-05 to 2026-09-23 range (spot-checked 2015-01-01, 2018-01-01, 2020-01-01, 2024-07-01 = all 200 OK). NOT every calendar date returns 200: confirmed 404 for weekends (expected) and also for some individual weekdays with no obvious holiday reason (2026-09-01 Tuesday = 404 while 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-02/03 = 200; this date is not on the official NSE/BSE 2026 trading-holiday list) and for the most recent 1-2 business days at check time (2026-09-24 Thu and 2026-09-25 Fri = 404 on 2026-09-27, while 2026-09-21/22/23 = 200) - i.e. there is an unexplained-scale gap risk PLUS a normal ~2-day publication lag. A production fetcher must tolerate isolated 404s and retry/backfill rather than assume every trading day succeeds.
sources.method: Plain HTTP GET with a standard browser User-Agent; no cookies, Referer or session needed (tested with and without - identical result). No rate-limiting encountered beyond politeness delay used.
sources.update_timing: Same-day file appears to go live roughly next morning (Last-Modified on the 2026-09-22 file was 2026-09-23 04:55 GMT ~ 10:25 IST).
sources.terms: Protean's site-wide disclaimer (npscra.proteantech.in/disclaimer.php, checked 2026-09-27) is a standard liability/limitation-of-use disclaimer; it does not grant or forbid redistribution of the NAV data itself.
sources.recommendation: Good independent cross-check / same-day monitoring source and a viable (if request-heavy) backfill path since it covers every scheme in one file per day, but the NPS Trust scheme-wise-nav-report-excel endpoint above is far more efficient for historical backfill (1 request per scheme vs. ~1 request per day for 17 years ~4,300 requests). Use CRA zip mainly for daily monitoring/verification, not bulk backfill.

sources.content: HTML form; POSTs to itself with select_pfm=<PFM code>. Returns LATEST NAV per scheme for the chosen PFM only - explicitly labelled 'For latest NAV, select the PFM from the drop down menu'. Also contains outbound links to several PFMs' own NAV-history pages (Axis, ICICI, Aditya Birla, Tata, UTI).
sources.method: HTTP POST with select_pfm form field; only useful for latest-NAV, not history.
sources.recommendation: Not needed once the daily-zip and NPS-Trust endpoints are used; documented here only because it is the page PFRDA/CRA point users to, and because it also implicitly confirms the same 'SMxxxxxx' / 'PFMxxx' coding scheme used elsewhere.

sources.url: https://nps.kfintech.com/Index/Index (public info) and https://cra.kfintech.in (CRA operations portal)
sources.publisher: KFin Technologies Ltd, Central Recordkeeping Agency #2 (appointed by PFRDA circular PFRDA/2017/1/CRA/1 dated 3 Jan 2017)
sources.content: KFintech's public NPS page advertises a 'Check Latest NPS NAV' tool and a 'Scheme NAV (Start Date) / Scheme NAV (End Date)' history lookup, and references the same 1 April 2026 Multiple-NAV/IMF-adjustment change independently.
sources.method: GAP - not tested. Time budget did not allow reverse-engineering KFintech's NAV-history query endpoint/params the way we did for NPS Trust and Protean.
sources.recommendation: Follow-up task: repeat the same discovery process (view-source / network-tab of the KFintech NAV-history widget) to see if it offers a bulk/date-range API. Not required for launch since NPS Trust already aggregates data sourced from all CRAs/PFMs in one place.

sources.publisher: Computer Age Management Services Ltd (CAMS), Central Recordkeeping Agency #3 (launched March 2022 per CAMS Annual Report FY2021-22 and PFRDA circular PFRDA/2022/12/SUP-CRA/3)
sources.content: CAMS CRA's own homepage advertises an 'NPS Calculator to estimate retirement corpus based on age, monthly contribution, expected rate of return' - note this is exactly the fixed-assumed-rate pattern this project must avoid; it is evidence of how a subscriber-facing CRA currently does it, not a data source to copy.
sources.method: GAP - not tested in the time available.
sources.recommendation: Same follow-up as KFintech. Low priority for the same reason (NPS Trust already aggregates across CRAs).

sources.content: Official Copyright Policy: 'Material featured on this site may be reproduced free of charge in any format or media without requiring specific permission... subject to the material being reproduced accurately and not being used in a derogatory manner or in a misleading context. Where the material is being published or issued to others, the source must be prominently acknowledged.' Third-party-owned material on the site is excluded and needs separate permission.
sources.terms: THIS IS THE CLOSEST EXPLICIT REUSE PERMISSION FOUND across PFRDA/NPS Trust/CRA sites. It is PFRDA-site-wide (not NPS-Trust- or CRA-specific, and not scoped explicitly to NAV/returns figures). No equivalent explicit copyright/reuse clause was found on npstrust.org.in or npscra.proteantech.in - both carry only generic liability disclaimers (see npstrust_weekly_snapshot_ui and cra_protean_daily_nav_zip entries) that neither grant nor forbid reuse of the data.
sources.recommendation: Attribute NAV/return figures to 'Source: NPS Trust (npstrust.org.in) / PFRDA (pfrda.org.in), data as of <date>' as a matter of good practice, matching PFRDA's own attribution requirement, even though NAV numbers as raw facts are unlikely to be independently copyrightable. GAP: no NPS-Trust- or CRA-specific terms-of-use for the NAV data itself were located; if a definitive answer is required, PFRDA/NPS Trust should be asked directly.

sources.content: Official current list of registered Pension Fund Managers (PFMs), asset-class exposure caps (Active Choice: E<=75% Tier I/100% Tier II, C<=100%, G<=100%, A<=5%), Multiple Scheme Framework (MSF) circular reference and list of ~20 MSF scheme names, and Investment Management Fee (IMF) slab table.
sources.update_timing: Reflects rules current as of check date; PFRDA updates this page as circulars are issued.
sources.recommendation: Primary citation for PFM list and asset-class caps.

sources.url: https://www.pfrda.org.in/documents/33652/184762/PFRDA%2BExits%2Band%2BWithdrawals%2Bunder%2Bthe%2BNPS%2BRegulations%2B2015%2B_Last%2Bamended%2Bon%2B20%2BJuly%2B2026_%2B(1).pdf ; consolidated FAQs at https://pfrda.org.in/documents/33652/676426/Exits%2Band%2BWithdrawals%2Bunder%2BNPS%2Bfor%2BAll%2BCitizen%2BModel.pdf (and sibling PDFs for Government/Corporate sectors)
sources.content: Full consolidated Exit & Withdrawal Regulations 2015 as last amended 20 July 2026, and plain-English FAQ PDFs per sector with the lump-sum/annuity tables used in nps_rules.json.
sources.update_timing: This is the 'last amended 20 July 2026' consolidated version - i.e. it already reflects the big December 2025 amendment described below AND at least one further 2026 amendment whose specific July-2026 changes were not individually itemised in the time available (see gaps in nps_summary.md).

sources.content: 19 December 2025 press release summarising the PFRDA (Exits and Withdrawals under the NPS) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 (notified 12 Dec 2025): non-government sector (All Citizen + Corporate) minimum-annuity share cut from 40% to 20% (lump sum raised 60%->80%); deferment age raised from 75 to 85; All Citizen Model vesting period changed to '15 years or 60, whichever is earlier'; vesting period removed entirely for those joining after age 60.
sources.recommendation: Primary citation for the 2025 exit-rule overhaul.

sources.content: Public notice dated 24 March 2026 explaining the Multiple NAV Framework effective 1 April 2026: differentiated Investment Management Fee for Government vs Non-Government subscribers, and Point-of-Presence (distributor) charges now adjusted directly through NAV rather than charged separately, giving 'Direct'/e-NPS subscribers a different (typically higher) NAV than POP-channel subscribers for what was previously a single scheme NAV.
sources.recommendation: CRITICAL citation - confirmed empirically in the downloaded NAV history itself: SBI Scheme E Tier I (SM001003) NAV history shows the exact same value on 2026-03-31 (51.6234) and 2026-04-01 under a NEW scheme code SM001025 'NPS TRUST A/C SBI PENSION FUND SCHEME E - TIER I DIRECT' (seamless continuation, confirmed by re-downloading raw/sm001003_hist.tsv and inspecting rows around the cutover). The simulator MUST decide, and document, which NAV series ('DIRECT'/e-NPS vs 'POP'/'GS') it uses post-1-April-2026 for each scheme; DIRECT is recommended as the default for a self-directed retail-saver tool.

sources.publisher: Independent open-source author (debpal), not PFRDA/NPS Trust/CRA affiliated
sources.content: Python package (pip-installable) wrapping the same npstrust.org.in nav-report-excel and scheme-wise-nav-report-excel endpoints documented above, plus PFM/scheme code lookups.
sources.history_depth: Same as underlying NPS Trust endpoints (from inception).
sources.method: pip install BharatFinTrack; used here only to DISCOVER the underlying official URLs, not as the data source itself.
sources.terms: Third-party code license, irrelevant to the underlying government data.
sources.recommendation: Useful corroboration that the npstrust.org.in endpoints are stable enough for a public package to depend on; do not cite as the data source of record (cite npstrust.org.in directly).

sources.publisher: Independent third party (rishikeshsreehari/npsnav on GitHub), not PFRDA/NPS Trust/CRA affiliated
sources.content: Free public JSON API mirroring Protean/CRA daily NAV data: latest NAV, latest-all-funds, and historical-per-scheme-code endpoints (e.g. https://npsnav.in/api/historical/SM001001), refreshed twice daily via GitHub Actions.
sources.format: JSON (not tested live by us - documented from its public README/docs only).
sources.history_depth: Claims full historical NAV per fund.
sources.method: Simple GET per documentation; not independently verified in this research session.
sources.update_timing: Twice daily per its own documentation (11am/11pm IST).
sources.terms: Third-party, dual MIT/CC-BY-NC-4.0-style license per its GitHub repo - i.e. NOT an official/government source; use only as a convenience fallback, never as the cited source of record for an 'official returns' claim.
sources.recommendation: Optional fallback/mirror only. Prefer npstrust.org.in directly since it is the primary official source and was confirmed working.
